source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find Tianxiang Pavilion Key (The Star Performer)
source_excerpt:
After reaching the Pavilion of Knowledge Crossroads Bell, head west to find the Cavalrybane boss, who drops the Armybreaker weapon. Once you defeat the boss, explore the arena and look to the left to find a locked door requiring the Tianxiang Pavilion Key . The key is tied to a quest from an NPC you meet later in Pangzhen , so keep exploring for now. This guide covers how to get the key and complete the quest.
How to Get the Tianxiang Pavilion Key in Phantom Blade Zero
From the Tianxiang Pavilion building, look around for the entrance to Myst's Tavern , where you need to go to progress through the main story . Once the cutscenes are over, enter the tavern and speak to the Leading Opera Actress among the gathered NPCs.
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
She will tell Soul a little about herself before asking him to retrieve her Dance Fan from Tianxiang Pavilion. According to her, the doorman has the key, and you can draw him out by burning some face powder in the censer down the alley near the Pavilion.
After speaking to her, you will receive Leading Actress's Rouge , which also starts the Star Performer quest. Return to Tianxiang Pavilion and use the Rouge to reveal several Ha-Ha enemies. Defeat them, and one of them will drop the Tianxiang Pavilion Key.
How to Get the Dance Fan in Phantom Blade Zero
With the key in your possession, unlock the Tianxiang Pavilion door and enter the building. You will encounter several Puppets inside, so defeat them before looting the area. You can find two Tainted Crystal Shards on this floor.
Next, head upstairs, where you will find two more Tainted Crystal Shards alongside several additional Puppets. At the end of this floor, you will also find the Tiger Paperweight , one of the treasures you need to collect for Quick Hand Zhang .
Climb the ladder to reach the next floor, where more Puppets await. Deal with them, then collect the Refined Indigo Crystal , two Traversal Talismans , and the Dancer's Ribbon (Soul Tempering Material).
Finally, approach the person dancing on this floor to obtain the Tattered Dance Fan . With the item collected, return to the Leading Opera Actress at Myst's Tavern and speak to her to complete the Star Performer quest.
Completing the Star Performer quest rewards you with the Dance Fan accessory. This accessory increases the damage dealt based on the distance traveled during an attack, up to a maximum of 40%.
You can also talk to Shopkeeper Niu in the Tavern to get the Huang Manor Key .
